74.steps:
1. Start new DHCP client on LAN interface
  2. Watch all ARP and ICMP echo requests from the router's LAN interface
  3. Verify DHCP client receives new IP address
  4. Verify router sends ARP requet for assigned IP address or ICMP echo for IP address before DHCP ACK is sent with client IP address. NOTE: Each DHCP server may use a different technique to probe a IPv4 address before assigning it to a client. For example, send an ARP Request, ICMP ping, etc. This test verifies that the router attempts to resolve an ARP request for the IPv4 address or send an ICMP echo before the address is assigned to a DHCP client. Reference: RFC 2131 Section 3.1 Client-Server Interaction
